# SystemVerilog for Hardware Design

## Concepts

Combinational and sequential logic, types, modules, interfaces, and synthesizable coding patterns.

## Implementation

Build arithmetic units, register files, and finite-state machines in SystemVerilog.

## Hands-on Experiments

Simulate each module, test boundary cases, and inspect synthesis results.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
